data.one_liner: A Dart package providing a stack data structure with push, pop, size, length, and top functionalities.
data.what_it_does: It implements a stack data structure in Dart. It supports basic operations like push, pop, inspecting the top element, checking size and length, and checking if items are contained.
use_when: You need a standard LIFO (last-in, first-out) stack data structure in your Dart or Flutter application.
You want to manage operations such as push, pop, and top inspection without implementing them manually.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions or asynchronous stream handling.
You only need built-in collection types like List and do not require formal stack abstractions.
strengths: Provides clear stack methods like push, pop, top, and size.
Supports null safety and works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
Includes a Sized constructor to control stack size constraints.
weaknesses: Limited in scope, handling only basic stack data structure features.
Throws an IllegalOperationException if top() or pop() is used on an empty stack.
